dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: A concise view of the Safir catalogue and the content that needs your attention.

cards.description: Manage every card available in Safir, including classification, translations, stats, and artwork.
cards.emptyDescription: Create your first Safir card to get started.
cards.createDescription: Add content, translations, classification, and artwork.
cards.editDescription: Update card data without changing its technical identifiers.
cards.paginationNote: Search currently filters the loaded catalogue server-side by name, number, and slug. Cursor-based Firestore pagination can be added when the catalogue outgrows this first back-office dataset.
cards.loadErrorDescription: Check the Firebase connection and try again.

seasons.description: Organize the Codex timeline and select the single season featured on the public home page.
seasons.emptyDescription: Create the first season before adding sets and cards.
seasons.createDescription: Add a localized season and configure its public visibility.
seasons.editDescription: Changes are validated server-side before Firestore is updated.

sets.description: Group cards into releases that belong to a specific season.
sets.emptyDescription: Create a set within one of your existing seasons.
sets.createDescription: Attach this release to one season and localize its public identity.
sets.editDescription: The season relationship is enforced again during every server mutation.

rarities.description: Manage rarities, their colors, icons, and display order.
rarities.emptyDescription: Create the rarities used to classify cards.
rarities.createDescription: Define a localized rarity with a clear color and catalogue order.
rarities.editDescription: Preview visual changes before saving them to the catalogue.

types.description: Maintain the multi-select taxonomy used to classify cards.
types.emptyDescription: Create the gameplay types available in card classification.
types.createDescription: Add a reusable card classification with localized labels.
types.editDescription: Update this type across every card that references it.

factions.title: Factions
factions.description: Manage the factions used by deck compatibility rules.
factions.emptyDescription: Create factions before assigning them to cards.
factions.createDescription: Add a stable, localized identity reusable by cards.
factions.editDescription: Cards retain its stable identifier when it changes.

glossary.description: Manage rules terms, stable keys, and localized definitions.
glossary.emptyDescription: Add the first rules term and its translations.
glossary.createDescription: Add a stable technical key, a slug, and localized definitions.
glossary.editDescription: The technical key stays stable while labels and definitions are localized.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: System configuration will be added as Safir administration grows.
settings.emptyDescription: No configuration is exposed in this first administration release.

dialogs.deleteDescription: This action cannot be undone. Associated assets may also be removed from storage.
